summary: Turbo Energy, S.A. filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release announcing commercial progress rather than a special situation. The Valencia-based energy storage integrator disclosed 15 firm-order C&I projects across Spain and Chile, with aggregate order value attributable to the company of approximately EUR 3 million (about US$3.48 million, converted at US$1.1604 per euro per the Fed H.10 rate for September 11, 2026), representing 15.6 MWh capacity and 5.95 MW power. No securities transaction, no board recommendation, no advisor, no deal terms. Watch execution and commissioning timing, not arbitrage.
